lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مَّسْكُوبٍ is in the derivative form: مَسْكوب
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/ك/ب s–k–b pouring out of liquid, flowing forth. Of this root, onlyمَسْكوب maskūb occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَسْكوب maskūb [pass. part.] poured out, made to flow

(56:31) وَمَاءٍ مَسْكُوبٍ and water made to flow.
